Name: realgoodsocial-security-headers
Comment: Security headers for site pages: CSP, COOP, HSTS with subdomains

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'
